title: Owner dashboard: projects, tasks and one-tap decisions
lead: One screen for every project: what is moving, what is stuck and what waits for your decision.

hero.caption: Decisions screen: the list of what waits for the owner; the open card «Delivery calculation» shows now / if accepted, with Accept, Reject and Discuss buttons (interface in Russian).
hero.alt: Decisions screen: the list of what waits for the owner; the open card «Delivery calculation» shows now / if accepted, with Accept, Reject and Discuss buttons (interface in Russian).

problem: Several projects, assistants on different computers, and ten windows to open to see where things stand. People want one place.
built: A home screen showing what waits for the owner, answered with a button.
Handing out tasks to assistants on different computers.
A gate before hand-over: a stage counts as done only after its checks pass.
Spend tracking, a knowledge base and a project showcase in the same dashboard.

shots.caption: Crew screen: assistant cards with the model (Haiku 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5), status and today's cost; on the right, which agents are working now (interface in Russian).
shots.alt: Crew screen: assistant cards with the model (Haiku 5.5 / Sonnet 5.5), status and today's cost; on the right, which agents are working now (interface in Russian).

shots.caption: A project on a phone: the overview tab, a decision «Cart page ready for review» with an Accept button, and a bottom bar with a voice button (interface in Russian).
shots.alt: A project on a phone: the overview tab, a decision «Cart page ready for review» with an Accept button, and a bottom bar with a voice button (interface in Russian).

steps: Open one screen and see every project.
See what waits for your decision and answer with one button, also from a phone.
Hand out tasks to assistants on different computers.
A stage is closed only when its checks pass.
offer: A similar dashboard for your team: projects, statuses, task hand-out, decision buttons.
not_included: A public link or a turnkey install; round-the-clock work with no human.
price_en: On request, after a short brief
